componentInstanceProperties.value: Metrios 332: everything you have ever wanted from an optical shop floor measuring machine

componentInstanceProperties.name: richTextValue
componentInstanceProperties.value:
The new Metrios 332 optical measuring machine was born to meet the demand of all component manufacturers who do not want to give up the precision guaranteed by multi-sensor machines, but who at the same time seek the speed and simplicity that only modern measuring systems can offer.

Metrios 332 represents the perfect synthesis of all these features, combining ease of use, speed, completeness, and precision in a single powerful solution built for operating on the shop floor.

componentInstanceProperties.name: richTextValue
componentInstanceProperties.value: All the details of the new Metrios model: advanced features for optimal performance

componentInstanceProperties.name: richTextValue
componentInstanceProperties.value:
A 300x300 mm X-Y measuring range and a generous 200 mm part passage: a wide measuring range combined with high part passage enables the Metrios 332 system to measure a wide range of parts, offering unparalleled flexibility and versatility.
 
Hold parts up-to 20 kg on the stage: a high load capacity on the stage allows even heavier parts to be placed on the working area.
 
A wide-field sensor detects the parts on the stage and measures them at maximum speed: achieve fast and reliable results thanks to the new sensor that detects the parts on the stage and measures in a matter of seconds.
 
A ultra-high magnification sensor for uncompromising accuracy: the new ultra-high magnification sensor can detect points in X-Y-Z even on the smallest details
 
A unique comprehensive lighting system: this shields from environmental light and ensures accurate and reliable measurement results even on the most difficult-to-detect surfaces.

componentInstanceProperties.name: richTextValue
componentInstanceProperties.value:
Metrios 332 measurement system represents a breakthrough in the metrology industry, thanks to its ability to combine the simplicity and speed of automatic optical measurement, with the completeness and accuracy of multi-sensor machines, directly in the production environment.

It is, therefore, an indispensable tool for workshops and manufacturers who want to maintain high quality standards and be always competitive in the market.
